answer: Seed indistinguishable honeypot items into the grading stream with verdicts known only to the protocol. Each is a planted vertex among real submissions, a dark lantern whose correct handling the protocol alone holds. A grader or cross-attesting identity that approves a decoy built to fail exposes itself, and because honeypots are statistically inseparable from genuine work, a colluding nebula of fakes cannot filter them out. As a ring grows and rubber-stamps more items, its odds of tripping a honeypot climb toward certainty.
